import re

HEAD = re.compile(r'^--\s+(?P<name>\S.*?)\s+-+\s*$')
KV = re.compile(r'^(?P<ind>\s*)(?P<key>[\w.\-]+): ?(?P<value>.*)$')
CONT = re.compile(r'^(?P<ind>\s+)(?P<value>\S.*)$')

def parse(lines):
    blocks = []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    last = None
    col = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = HEAD.match(line)
        if m:
            cur = {'name': m.group('name'), 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': [{}]}
            blocks.append(cur)
            skip.append(i)
            last = None
            col = None
            continue
        if cur is None:
            cur = {'name': 'sys', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': [{}]}
            blocks.append(cur)
        c = CONT.match(line)
        if c and last is not None and col is not None and len(c.group('ind')) >= col:
            rec = cur['records'][0]
            v = rec[last]
            rec[last] = (v + '\n' + c.group('value').rstrip()) if v else c.group('value').rstrip()
            cur['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        m = KV.match(line)
        if m:
            key = m.group('key')
            rec = cur['records'][0]
            rec[key] = m.group('value').rstrip()
            cur['lines'].append(i)
            last = key
            col = len(m.group('ind')) + len(key) + 2
            continue
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
